settings.heading: What people say about Dear Paws

settings.question: What is inside the Cat Advent Calendar?
settings.answer: 24 numbered doors, each hiding a different surprise: a Santa teaser wand, crinkle fish, feather and plush mice, jingle balls, rattles, collars, spring coils and more. No two days are the same.

settings.question: Is it suitable for kittens?
settings.answer: Yes. Everything is sized for kittens and adult cats alike. As with any new toy, supervise your cat at first and remove any piece that becomes damaged.

settings.question: When should I order to receive it before December 1st?
settings.answer: Orders placed before November 20th typically arrive in time for the first door. We ship from Canada with tracking on every order.

settings.question: Does it come ready to gift?
settings.answer: It does. The calendar arrives in its festive gift box with no prices shown, so it can go straight under the tree.

settings.question: Can I buy one for a cat and one for a dog?
settings.answer: Yes. We make a Paw Advent Calendar for dogs as well. Add each one to your cart separately and they ship together.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: If you or your cat are not happy within 30 days, contact us and we will make it right with a replacement or a full refund.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: Yes, shipping is free on every order. Add shipping protection at checkout to cover loss or damage in transit.
